name_en: Oyama tofu dishes — chilled and hot-pot tofu made with Tanzawa spring water
summary_ja: 丹沢山系の清らかな水でつくる伊勢原市大山の豆腐料理。大山詣りの参拝客に振る舞われて名物となり、冷奴や湯豆腐、田楽など素材の味を生かした食べ方が受け継がれている。
summary_en: Tofu dishes from Mount Oyama in Isehara City, made with clear water from the Tanzawa mountains. Served to pilgrims visiting the mountain shrine, it became a local specialty, still enjoyed simply as chilled tofu, hot pot tofu, or grilled tofu with miso.
source_title: 大山の豆腐料理 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Yokosuka navy curry — thickened curry recreating the old Imperial Navy recipe
summary_ja: 牛肉や鶏肉と野菜をとろみのあるカレーで煮込み、ごはんにかける横須賀市の料理。旧日本海軍の給食として脚気対策に導入されたカレーを再現したもので、平成の街おこしから名物になったと伝わる。
summary_en: A Yokosuka City dish of beef or chicken and vegetables simmered in a thickened curry and served over rice. It recreates the curry once served in the old Imperial Japanese Navy to combat beriberi, and is said to have become a local specialty through a Heisei-era town revival effort.
source_title: よこすか海軍カレー 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Wakasagi no kanroni — smelt from Lake Ashinoko candied to a glossy finish
summary_ja: 芦ノ湖でとれたワカサギを素焼きにしてから水あめで照りをつけて煮る箱根町の郷土料理。甘辛くしっかり味付けして日持ちさせた保存食で、正月には定番の一品として食卓に並ぶと伝わる。
summary_en: A Hakone dish of smelt from Lake Ashinoko, first dry-grilled and then simmered to a glossy finish with starch syrup. Seasoned firmly sweet and salty to keep well, it is said to be a standard dish on the New Year table.
source_title: ワカサギの甘露煮 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_ja: のらぼう菜のおひたし
name_en: Norabouna no ohitashi — blanched norabou greens dressed simply
summary_ja: 川崎市多摩区菅地区で育つ伝統野菜ののらぼう菜をゆでてお浸しにする料理。江戸時代の飢饉で人々を救ったと伝わる強い野菜で、ほのかな甘みとやわらかな食感をシンプルに楽しむ。
summary_en: A dish of norabouna, a traditional vegetable grown in the Suge district of Kawasaki City, blanched and served as a simple dressed side. Said to have helped people survive an Edo-period famine, it is enjoyed simply for its faint sweetness and tender texture.
source_title: のらぼう菜のおひたし 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tanishi no misoni — river snails simmered with burdock in sweet miso
summary_ja: 厚木市飯山温泉周辺に伝わる、田にしを甘辛い味噌でごぼうと一緒に煮込む郷土料理。かつて花祭りの屋台に並んだ名物で「たにし町」と呼ばれるほど身近だったが、今はほとんど食べられなくなったと伝わる。
summary_en: A dish from around Iiyama hot spring in Atsugi City, river snails simmered with burdock in a sweet-savory miso. Once so common it lined festival stalls and gave the area the nickname 'Tanishi Town,' it is said to be rarely eaten today.
source_title: 田にしの味噌煮 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Shumai — ground pork and onion wrapped in a thin skin and steamed
summary_ja: 豚ひき肉やタマネギを皮で包んで蒸す横浜市の名物料理。中華街の点心にヒントを得た駅弁のシウマイが全国に知られるようになり、市民の食卓に今も深く根づいていると伝わる。
summary_en: A Yokohama specialty of ground pork and onion wrapped in a thin skin and steamed. Inspired by dim sum from Chinatown, a station bento version made it famous nationwide, and the city is said to still lead the country in shumai consumption.
source_title: シューマイ 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Yude rakkasei — peanuts boiled in their shells with salt
summary_ja: 殻付きのまま塩ゆでする秦野市周辺の郷土料理。日本で初めて落花生栽培が始まった土地で、出荷できない未熟豆を農家がおやつに茹でていたものが、冷凍商品化を機に広まったと伝わる。
summary_en: A dish from around Hadano City, peanuts boiled in their shells with salt. In the region where peanut cultivation first began in Japan, farmers are said to have boiled unripe, unsellable pods as a snack, a practice that spread widely once it was turned into a frozen product.
source_title: 茹で落花生 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
